title: 2.1.42 Grade Recommendation Advisor
description: Use score, attendance, and lateAssignments to print a grade recommendation. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed: capstone lab, assignment code A2.1.1 per curriculum-plan §2.1 Assignments; draws on book 2.1.1 if, 2.1.3 else, 2.1.4 else if, and 2.1.8 combining conditions

steps.title: Declare the three hardcoded variables
steps.instructions: Create score (0-100), attendance (0-100, a percent), and lateAssignments (a count) and give each a hardcoded number value.

steps.title: Chain a grade recommendation on score
steps.instructions: Write an else if chain (at least two else if branches) that picks a recommendation string based on score, for example 'Recommend: A', 'Recommend: B', and so on down to a lowest tier.

steps.title: Adjust the recommendation with attendance and lateAssignments
steps.instructions: Add a condition that uses && or || to combine attendance and lateAssignments (for example: attendance is below 90 OR lateAssignments is 3 or more) and, when true, logs a warning that the recommendation should be reviewed.

steps.title: Print the final recommendation
steps.instructions: Use console.log to print the grade recommendation and, if it applies, the review warning.
